how: Each case is laid out by yoga-layout 3.2.1 (parity/yoga.mjs) and by the engine (tests/yoga.rs); boxes must be identical. A measured leaf returns [w, h] clamped by Yoga's offer: the offered size when the mode is Exactly, the smaller of the two when AtMost, its own size when Undefined. expected.boxes are [left, top, width, height] for every node in depth-first order.
